Esenler Erokspor Kulübü is a Turkish professional sports club based in Esenler, Istanbul. Founded on 16 November 1959, the club is best known for its football department, which currently competes in the TFF First League, the second tier of the Turkish football league system. The team plays its home matches at the Esenler Stadium, which has an all-seater capacity of 5,291.
